title: L^p spaces
summary: Convex functions and Jensen's inequality; Hölder's and Minkowski's inequalities; the L^p spaces for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞ as normed spaces and the Riesz–Fischer theorem (completeness); density of compactly supported continuous functions in L^p for p < ∞ and in C_0; inclusions between L^p spaces, local L^p spaces, convexity of the L^p norm, density of smooth functions.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 14–17 of the 18.125 notes.

preparation.description: Read lecture 14: convex functions, Jensen, Hölder and Minkowski.
Read lecture 15: L^p spaces, normed and Banach spaces, the Riesz–Fischer theorem.
Read lecture 16: density of C_c in L^p (p < ∞) and in C_0.
Read lecture 17: inclusions between L^p and l^p spaces, local L^p spaces, convexity of the norm, density of smooth functions.
